mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, product_id, quantity, is_selected, gmt_create, gmt_modified FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT id, user_id, product_id, quantity, is_selected, gmt_create, gmt_modified FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart (user_id, product_id, quantity, is_selected) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{isSelected})
mapper.update: UPDATE cart SET quantity = #{quantity}, is_selected = #{isSelected} WHERE id = #{id}
